Below is the plan for each class day. {{< fa book >}} links to the online book chapter and {{< fa person-chalkboard >}} to that day's slides. The **Activity** column shows the day's format and any graded event: a **lecture** ({{< fa pen-ruler >}}), a **Q&A panel** discussion ({{< fa comments >}}), a **simulation** ({{< fa gamepad >}}), or the **midterm**. A short auto-graded **quiz** ({{< fa clipboard-question >}}) or a **homework** due date ({{< fa pen >}}) appears alongside and links to the assignment.

On lecture days we develop the model at the board and work an example. On **Q&A panel** days a randomly drawn panel discusses the reading while the rest of the class earns points asking questions, and **simulation** days replace discussion with an in-class game and a debrief. Check-in, the panel draw, quizzes, and the question queue all run through our class platform (Commons).

The schedule is provisional --- topics, readings, and the exact placement of quizzes and simulations may shift as the term unfolds.
